iterations.name: Compile experiments before rendering
iterations.weakness: Prompt text flattens quantities, entities, separate samples, time and observations.
iterations.hypothesis: A typed protocol compiler prevents contradictory shots before spending GPU time.
adds: source-resolved protocol intermediate representation
persistent apparatus and sample IDs
explicit contact and event dependencies
source quantity intervals and unknowns
separate process time, generated time and presented time
alternatives: Prompt expansion alone: cheap but does not enforce invariants.
Train a new science model immediately: costly and unsupported by the current reviewed data.
iterations.failure_probe: Try compiling repeated aliquots, stock preparations and missing doses; reject accidental dose multiplication and conflated samples.
iterations.test: Compare same source plans with and without compilation; count invalid plans and independently reviewed procedural errors.
iterations.success_unlocks: A dependency graph can drive reusable references and grounded handoffs.
iterations.remaining_weakness: A correct requested state still does not prove the video achieved it.

iterations.name: Make continuity evidence-dependent
iterations.weakness: Final-frame similarity does not establish action completion, identity or volume continuity.
iterations.hypothesis: An uncertainty-aware state ledger prevents unsupported scientific state from propagating.
adds: desired, observed and accepted state kept separate
entity-scoped predicates with evidence intervals
three-valued pass/fail/unknown state
hash-bound source/reference/video/reviewer lineage
consumer-specific handoff preconditions
alternatives: Use the last frame unconditionally: cheap but can propagate a failed action.
Trust a VLM numeric score: not calibrated for these chemistry claims.
iterations.failure_probe: A plausible final frame hides a missing pour; a blurred meniscus is unknown rather than proof of volume.
iterations.test: Compare final-frame chaining with evidence-qualified chaining at matched compute; measure transition precision, false acceptance and full-sequence success.
iterations.success_unlocks: Explicit uncertainty identifies which next observation or repair would actually help.
iterations.remaining_weakness: Reviewing every predicate on every frame can dominate total cost.

iterations.name: Choose evidence and rendering before expensive generation
iterations.weakness: Correctness checks may be too costly or impossible in an unreadable camera view.
iterations.hypothesis: Cheap visibility and motion previews can eliminate unjudgeable shots and route exact content to deterministic renderers.
adds: image-hash-bound target regions and occlusion status
projected visibility checks at actual output and fallback resolution
lightweight candidate motion/contact previews
renderer capabilities for photoreal footage, calibrated overlays and labelled diagrams
human review escalation for unsupported semantic checks
alternatives: Increase resolution everywhere: memory cost without guaranteed observability.
Automatically replace failed footage with diagrams: changes the task and can contaminate comparisons.
iterations.failure_probe: A rim hides paper contact, a low-area fallback makes a drop invisible, or an explanatory animation is mistaken for a real observation.
iterations.test: Visibility-only and preview-only ablations; compare time lost to rejected shots, judgeability and annotation labour.
iterations.success_unlocks: Renderer and visibility requirements become constraints for a measured compute scheduler.
iterations.remaining_weakness: A good preview does not guarantee that the unconstrained Wan output follows its trajectory.

iterations.name: Spend compute on accepted scientific progress
iterations.weakness: Uniform clips, unmeasured optimizations and repeated expert loading waste limited memory and wall time.
iterations.hypothesis: A conservative scheduler can choose among measured feasible profiles and repair only scientifically affected descendants.
adds: hardware/model/version-specific profile registry
uncertainty and visibility constrained profile selection
per-sample sequential execution with optional scheduling across independent jobs
failure-type-specific repair and descendant invalidation
all-attempt compute ledger and cold/warm/resume distinction
separate model-adapter experiments for longer native generation
alternatives: Batch all dependent clips by expert: violates decoded-state dependencies.
Always lower resolution and upscale: may erase a decisive scientific detail.
Enable every cache/kernel/offload option at once: attribution and feasibility become unclear.
iterations.failure_probe: A warm cache profile is used for a cold session, an OOM fallback hides a target, or a cheaper profile increases rerenders.
iterations.test: Matched wall-time and matched-attempt comparisons against the fixed safe_2s baseline; record VRAM, host RAM, disk, cache hits and all repair cost.
iterations.success_unlocks: A measured quality/cost frontier can support active selection of the next experiment.
iterations.remaining_weakness: The policy can exploit an incomplete verifier or improve easy clips while failing unseen families.

iterations.name: Make the system challenge itself and learn what to test next
iterations.weakness: Generator and verifier can share misconceptions; apparent gains may reflect cherry-picking or leaked templates.
iterations.hypothesis: Independent adversarial/causal evaluation plus family-held-out tests reveals real scientific progress and guides subsequent development.
adds: expert-labelled wrong-order, missing-action, wrong-target and duplicate-apparatus challenges
source-validated causal pairs with no prompt/reference contradictions
blinded external review and reviewer calibration
family-level holdouts, paired seeds and complete attempt manifests
separate photoreal and hybrid evaluation tracks
active experiment selection by expected information gain per total cost
later misconception and retention study
alternatives: Publish one aggregate realism percentage: hides procedural failure.
Let one model generate and grade its own answers: shared failure modes.
Treat every pilot ID as an independent experiment: pseudoreplication from reused sources and images.
iterations.failure_probe: A verifier accepts a beautiful incorrect clip, a causal pair changes several conditions, or a policy overfits the evaluation set.
iterations.test: Freeze evaluation families and scoring before policy tuning; report false acceptance, coverage, sequence success and costs with uncertainty.
iterations.success_unlocks: A reusable source/evidence dataset, calibrated decision policy and curriculum-aware generation research programme.
iterations.remaining_weakness: Expert disagreement, limited sources, renderer domain shift and scarce GPU evidence remain; further claims depend on actual experiments.
